summary.zh-TW: 以現金付清帳上全部應付帳款 {{money:derived.amount}}。
summary.en: Pay all trade payables on the books, {{money:derived.amount}}, in cash.

label.zh-TW: 要付的貨款（帳上應付帳款餘額）

message.zh-TW: 帳上沒有應付帳款可以付。
message.en: There are no trade payables to pay.

message.zh-TW: 帳上現金不夠付這筆款項。
message.en: There is not enough cash on the books for this payment.

explanation.zh-TW: 付款時現金減少、應付帳款也減少，獲利不變，因為成本早在賣出商品時就認列了。金額直接讀帳上的應付帳款餘額，所以前面賒購的金額改了，這裡也會跟著變。付出的現金列在營業活動的支付供應商。
explanation.en: Paying the supplier reduces cash and trade payables by the same amount; profit is unchanged because the cost was recognised when the goods were sold. The amount is read from the trade payables balance, so a change to the earlier credit purchase flows through here. The cash paid appears under operating activities as cash paid to suppliers.
